definitions.explanation: Extremely small in size, scale, or detail. Used for particles, structures, differences, and other things that are difficult to perceive with the naked eye or require close examination.

examples.japanese: {微細|びさい}な⟦{粒子|りゅうし}→粒子：14970_ryuushi⟧。
{微細|びさい}な⟦{違|ちが}い→違い：03432_chigai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見分|みわ}ける→見分ける：06348_miwakeru⟧。

⟦{顕微鏡|けんびきょう}→顕微鏡：05482_kenbikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧しか⟦{見|み}えない→見える：01165_mieru⟧ほど{微細|びさい}な⟦{構造|こうぞう}→構造：02730_kouzou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{生命|せいめい}→生命：03296_seimei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕組|しく}み→仕組み：07168_shikumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支|ささ}えている→支える：01946_sasaeru⟧。
examples.english: Microscopic structures invisible to the naked eye support the mechanisms of life.

notes:
FORMS:
- Modifier: {微細|びさい}な
- Adverbial: {微細|びさい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧

USAGE:
{微細|びさい} is a formal, often technical or scientific word. It is frequently used in academic writing, manufacturing, and medicine to describe extremely small scales.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {微細|びさい}な⟦{粒子|りゅうし}→粒子：14970_ryuushi⟧: fine particles
- {微細|びさい}な⟦{構造|こうぞう}→構造：02730_kouzou⟧: fine structure, microstructure
- {微細|びさい}な⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧: minute changes
- {微細|びさい}⟦{加工|かこう}→加工：11793_kakou⟧: microfabrication, micro-processing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {微細|びさい}: minute, microscopic (technical, scientific)
- ⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧: fine, detailed (everyday)
- ⟦{微小|びしょう}→微小：20095_bishou⟧: tiny, minuscule (emphasizes smallness)
- ⟦{精密|せいみつ}→精密：13775_seimitsu⟧: precise, fine (emphasizes precision)
